meta.tagline: Get ready for the Digital Product Passport

footer.about: Tools and advice to design your Digital Product Passport under the ESPR Regulation.

wizard.title: Design your Digital Product Passport
wizard.intro: Answer a few questions about your company and product: at the end you will get a maturity score, an architecture sketch and recommended next steps. All you need to start is a free account.
wizard.registerFirst: To start, create a free account: all you need is an email and a password.
wizard.stepsIntro: {count} questions, about {minutes} minutes. Marked questions only appear if relevant to your previous answers.

assistant.title: Not sure about this question?
assistant.ctaHint: Write to the site's expert: the answer will appear here, on this step.
assistant.intro: Not sure how to answer? Write to the site's expert.
assistant.expertNote: The site's expert will answer. The reply will appear here: come back to this step from the same browser, or sign up at the end of the journey to find it from any device.

errors.invalid: Write a question between 3 and 1000 characters.
errors.limitExpert: You already have several questions waiting: please wait for the expert's reply.
errors.unavailable: Assistant unavailable: try again shortly or ask the expert.

references.title: Regulatory references
references.note: Indicative references: always check the official text and the delegated acts that apply to your product.

wizard.mandatoryWarning: Note: for this category the law requires the “{options}” level. You can clear the selection, but the passport will still have to meet the obligation.
wizard.matrixHint: For each category select one or more levels: different products in the same category may need different levels.
wizard.matrixNoRows: Go back to the previous step and select at least one category.
wizard.needsReview: An earlier answer changed: please check this answer.
wizard.noPersonalData: Do not enter personal data (names, emails, phone numbers) in this field.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

summary.title: Your result
summary.noRecommendations: No specific recommendations: your journey is well set up.
summary.saveBody: Sign up to save the journey and access it from any device. Without an account you can resume it from this browser for 30 days.
summary.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
summary.pdfBody: The full summary to share: diagrams, score, next steps and all your answers, with links to the guide and the regulatory references.
summary.lockedTitle: Download the PDF report and the diagrams as PNG and SVG
summary.lockedBody: Downloads are available to registered users. Registration is free: the project is saved to your account and you can open it from any device.

example.title: An example result
example.intro: At the end you get your DPP Blueprint, the data flow and the recommended next steps. Here they are for an example company: an e-bike battery manufacturer that needs a passport for every single battery.
example.hint: Example: click a card to read the question in the guide.
example.note: Example answers: your results depend on your answers.
